subject: MAP: Integration build plan (SDK, streaming, tool-calling, structured outputs)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Turner <sam.turner@acme.com>, Lia Chen <lia.chen@acme.dev>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 22 Mar 2026 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: Integration build plan (SDK, streaming, tool-calling, structured outputs)

Hi Sam / Lia —

Thanks again for the call earlier. As promised, attaching a first-draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP) focused on the integration milestone we discussed: SDK integration, streaming support, tool-calling hooks, and structured outputs mapping. High-level recap and proposed next steps below.

Key milestones (proposed):
- Milestone 1 — SDK integration (JavaScript + Python): sample SDK + quickstart + auth flow. Owner: TBD. Target: 2026-04-15
- Milestone 2 — Streaming / low-latency path: support streaming responses for chat & tool-calls. Owner: TBD. Target: 2026-04-22
- Milestone 3 — Tool-calling integration: define tool schema & secure invocation path. Owner: TBD. Target: 2026-04-29
- Milestone 4 — Structured outputs (JSON schemas, validation): output contracts and regression tests. Owner: TBD. Target: 2026-05-06

Dependencies we flagged on the call:
- Final model selection (open model vs managed) — impacts tokenization and SDK examples
- Auth & network (CORS / VPC routing) — need infra sign-off
- Schema for tool-calls from Acme side (list of callable endpoints + auth)

Attached: MAP_Draft_Acme_v1.xlsx (milestone table + timeline) and Integration_Specs.pdf (initial tech notes).

Ask / next steps:
1) Can Acme confirm the preferred target close date for the POC (we proposed 2026-05-15)?
2) Please assign an owner from your engineering team for integration coordination (SDK + test harness).
3) Internal: we should assign internal owners and confirm resource availability — suggest assigning by tomorrow EOD.

I'll update the attached MAP with owners once we have confirmation.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales (West)
Redwood Inference
[attachment: MAP_Draft_Acme_v1.xlsx]
[attachment: Integration_Specs.pdf]

From: Lia Chen <lia.chen@acme.dev>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Sam Turner <sam.turner@acme.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 23 Mar 2026 09:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: Integration build plan (SDK, streaming, tool-calling, structured outputs)

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap and the draft MAP. Appreciate you pulling this together. A few quick notes from our side after internal sync:

- Target POC completion of 2026-05-15 works for us as a goal; our preferred target close date for the initial integration (internal sign-off) would be 2026-05-20 to allow QA time.
- Owners from Acme: Sam will be executive lead; I'll coordinate engineering workstreams — primary point for integration is me (lia.chen@acme.dev).
- Dependencies: we need a short statement of how authentication will work (API key vs OAuth) and any network requirements (CORS, IP allowlist) so we can engage infra/security.

On Milestones:
- SDK: we prefer prioritized JS SDK first, then Python. A lightweight sample app would help.
- Streaming: critical for our chat UX — latency budget: 300ms initial token.
- Tool-calling: we'll provide a schema for our internal endpoints but need Redwood to document the expected invocation payloads and error model.
- Structured outputs: we will own the final JSON schema but need Redwood to implement validation hooks.

I'll review the attached MAP and send a short owner list by EOD. Can you confirm who at Redwood will be the internal owners for the four milestones?

Thanks,
Lia
Lead Product Engineer
Acme Corp

On Sun, Mar 22, 2026 at 3:05 PM Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai> wrote:
> (see above)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Lia Chen <lia.chen@acme.dev>, Sam Turner <sam.turner@acme.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 23 Mar 2026 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: Integration build plan (SDK, streaming, tool-calling, structured outputs)

Thanks Marissa / Lia — quick internal alignment from my side. Per the dependencies and Redwood resourcing, proposing the following internal owners and immediate asks so we can update the MAP: 

Proposed Redwood owners (please confirm):
- SDK integration (JS + Python quickstarts, auth examples) — Owner: Aditya Rao (aditya.rao@redwood.ai)
- Streaming / low-latency path (server hooks + sample streaming client) — Owner: Laura Bennett (laura.bennett@redwood.ai)
- Tool-calling integration (schema + secure invocation) — Owner: Stephanie Nguyen (stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai)
- Structured outputs (JSON schema support + validators) — Owner: Vivek Kulkarni (vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai)

Immediate asks for Acme to unblock scheduling:
- Confirm auth approach (API key or OAuth) and provide any existing IP/CORS constraints
- Share initial tool schema (even a stub) so Stephanie can map invocation patterns
- Confirm JS-focused sample app requirements (framework, bundling needs)

I'll slot Aditya/Laura/Stephanie to a 30-minute technical kickoff with Lia (and Sam if helpful) — propose Wed 2026-03-25 10:00 AM PT. Lia, does that work?

I'll update the MAP spreadsheet with these owner assignments and the updated target dates (shifting to Acme's suggested QA buffer).

Thanks,
Vivek
Head of Platform Partnerships
Redwood Inference

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>

Date: Tue, 24 Mar 2026 10:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: Integration build plan (SDK, streaming, tool-calling, structured outputs)

Confirmed — I'll own the SDK integration work. Tentative plan / 2-week deliveries:
- Week 1 (by 2026-04-01): JS SDK quickstart, auth example (API-key flow), sample fetch-based client
- Week 2 (by 2026-04-08): Python SDK wrapper + sample notebook, CI tests for auth flows

Notes / blockers:
- Need sample account creds from Acme for testing (read-only) or a mocked endpoint.
- Please confirm whether CORS/IP allowlist will require dev VPN access.

I can join the Wed 3/25 10:00am PT kickoff.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Software Engineer II, Integrations
Redwood Inference
